messages:
andrew-partnerships: Quick sync — partners sent updated SKU feeds but missing reserved vs spot split and IO-credit/hard-commit windows. We need this for our Q3 cost model. Can you drop a CSV here?
partners-bot: Uploaded file: https://files.redwood/feeds/partner_supply_q3.csv :paperclip:
nikita-finance: Important — please include list price per GPU-hour + any volume tiers. we'll model invoice cadence. Also need which billing zone (US/EU/APAC).
jess-engineering: Also include preemptibility profile (eviction probability) and any holdback window (e.g., partner keeps 5% for failover). affects our fallback routing.
sam-ops: For mapping: give SKU, region, hardware_family, reserved_term_mo, reserved_pct, spot_pct, spot_eviction_rate, io_credits_per_month. Example CSV header:
```
sku,region,hardware_family,reserved_term_mo,reserved_pct,spot_pct,spot_eviction_rate,io_credits_per_month,price_per_gpu_hour
```
charlie-analytics: For modeling, we need time-series of historical spot fills if available (daily fill rate last 90d) — can be a separate CSV.
andrew-partnerships: @nikita-finance @jess-engineering prioritize missing fields: reserved_pct, spot_pct, holdback_pct, io_credits, commit_end_date. We're on a deadline Tuesday to lock rates.
partners-bot: Partner note from AuroraCompute: "We apply a 7-day holdback for burst protection, + IO credit bucket sizes in GB." Attached metadata: aurora_meta_v2.json
nikita-finance: OK — will assume holdback_pct=5-7% for baseline, flag scenario with 0% and 10%.
jess-engineering: Also call out latency premium for reserved in APAC (+10ms) per partner SLA — that'll change routing cost-weight.
sam-ops: I'll draft mapping rules for fallbacks: prefer reserved within region, then spot same region, then cross-region reserved, then marketplace ephemeral. I'll post a PR with policy yaml.
andrew-partnerships: Thanks — once PR and CSV with headers exist we'll feed into cost model. If partners can add spot eviction time-of-day curve that's gold. :money_with_wings:
charlie-analytics: I'll prepare two scenarios: conservative (high eviction & 10% holdback) and optimistic (low eviction & 0% holdback) and run by marketing for joint announcement risk.
nikita-finance: One ask — include whether IO credits are transferable between SKUs or pooled per account. That changes effective unit economics.
andrew-partnerships: Looping in @partners-bot to track file updates. Target: finalize inputs by Mon EOD so pricing grid can be set Wed. :calendar:
